messages:
sophie_csm: FYI — we have ~12 onboarding tenants (private VPC) reporting intermittent auth failures since ~2026-03-20 09:12 UTC. This is impacting batch onboarding jobs and some webhooks. I want a coordinated cs -> eng -> ops outreach + a runbook for customers. Can ops/eng confirm root cause and mitigation?

maria_cs: Ack. compiling affected list now. will DM creds to the outreach owners.

jordan_se: Looking into logs. Initial signal shows token validation errors from the private control plane after a deploy. suspect config rotation race.

kyle_eng: @jordan_se can you paste the error snippet?
jordan_se: sure — snippet: `{"error":"invalid_token","code":401,"context":"kv-store lookup failed for tenant_key"}`

praveen_ops: We saw a KMS agent restart around 09:10 UTC on the control plane nodes in eu-west-1. Possible race where new keyID not yet propagated to tenants. Rolling hotfix to queueing/refresh logic.

ops_bot: Deploy started: hotfix/control-plane-token-refresh v2.3.1 — rolling 3 nodes — eta ~18m

sophie_csm: Good. while eng/ops do the fix we need: 1) outbound outreach template, 2) temporary workaround for tenants (self-serve toggle), 3) list of high-risk renewals to escalate. I'll draft msg and loop AE's.

leslie_account_exec: Please flag any accounts with renewal date <60d and ARR >$50k. I want to be on calls if they escalate.

maria_cs: Draft message — please review: 
"Hi <FirstName>, we’re investigating authentication failures affecting onboarding tasks in private VPC deployments. Our engineers are applying a hotfix; in the meantime you can toggle to the hosted control plane as a temporary workaround from Console -> Settings -> Control Plane (set to Hosted). We’ll follow up with an RCA and a credit for any failed onboarding runs. ETA ~2 hrs."

sophie_csm: Nice. Add: "If you prefer we can toggle for you; reply with your tenant ID."

kyle_eng: Workaround check command for CS to verify status: 
```bash
# check tenant onboarding status
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN" \
  "https://internal-api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/status?tenant_id=TENANT_ID" | jq .
```

jordan_se: Hotfix completed on first 2 nodes. Full rollout in progress. We've also added a safety check to delay KMS rotation until all control-plane agents confirm key availability.

praveen_ops: Confirmed — control plane health checks green across eu-west-1. Ops will monitor 60m.

sophie_csm: Team — action items: 
- @maria_cs: send the outbound message to affected tenants + offer toggle help (use AE list)
- @leslie_account_exec: reach out to flagged renewals (I'll add a short script to identify >$50k ARR, renewals <60d)
- @kyle_eng, @jordan_se: postmortem + RCA draft in #postmortems when ready
- @praveen_ops: hold monitoring and confirm rollback conditions if errors resume

maria_cs: Sending now. sample personalized line: "Sophie from Redwood here — I can flip this for you right away if you want me to." 

leslie_account_exec: On standby for calls. Thx.

ops_bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0319-auth-rotation — severity: medium — affected tenants: 12 — owner: praveen_ops

sophie_csm: Also capturing feedback: after outreach, send affected customers a 2-question pulse: 1) Did toggling control plane resolve your issue? 2) How would you rate impact on your onboarding (1-5)? We'll map responses to renewal-risk score.

kyle_eng: RCA summary (preliminary): KMS rotation initiated during deployment; control-plane agents tried to read new keyID before it was present in tenant KV-store -> token validation failures. Fix: add propagation barrier + backoff on key fetch. Deploying in all regions tonight.

jordan_se: ETA for global rollout of the fix: 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC. If we see recurrence we will rollback rotation and run manual propagation.

maria_cs: Outreach sent to 12 tenants (template + toggle offer). 3 replies already asking to flip them. Doing flips for the ones with urgent onboarding runs.

sophie_csm: Great. For bookkeeping: we will offer 10% credit on onboarding bill for affected runs and note in renewal playbooks for any account that replies negative on the pulse and has renewal <90d.

leslie_account_exec: Noted — will add to weekly renewal risk sync. please DM the list of accounts I should bump.

praveen_ops: Monitoring looks stable. Will keep this thread updated. If anyone sees fresh 401s post-23:00 UTC, tag me immediately.

maria_cs: Closing loop: all 12 tenants have either been toggled or confirmed green. 2 tenants requested AE calls — scheduled. Sending follow-up RCA email once engineering posts full writeup.

sophie_csm: Thanks everyone. I'll convert this thread into a short CS playbook (runbook) and upload to Confluence: https://confluence.internal.redwood.ai/display/CS/tenant-auth-rotation-runbook — includes: checklist, outbound templates, monitoring queries, escalation matrix.

kyle_eng: Posting full RCA in #postmortems now. Will ping when live.

ops_bot: Incident INC-2026-0319-auth-rotation marked as resolved (monitoring).

sophie_csm: Excellent. Final note for records: impact window 09:10–09:40 UTC, affected: 12 onboarding tenants, mitigation: host control plane toggle + hotfix; customer credit: 10% onboarding bill; next steps: RCA + postmortem link in thread.

maria_cs: added outcomes to customer records and closed ticket queue for this incident.

leslie_account_exec: Thanks team — good coordination.

sophie_csm: Thread archived into the CS incident folder and runbook drafted. If anything else crops up re-open. :white_check_mark:
